features.name: Selective Door Unlocking
features.description: First press unlocks driver door; second press unlocks passenger and boot doors.

features.name: Auto-Locking (>15 km/h)
features.description: Automatically locks all doors once vehicle speed reaches 15 km/h.

features.name: Auto-Unlock on Key Removal
features.description: Unlocks vehicle doors automatically when ignition key is pulled from ignition barrel.

features.name: Acoustic Lock Confirmation (Horn/Siren Chirp)
features.description: Emits short acoustic chirp upon vehicle locking via remote fob.

features.name: Optical Indicator Blink on Lock
features.description: Flashes turn indicators once when vehicle is locked.

features.name: Comfort Window Operation via Remote
features.description: Allows opening/closing windows by holding lock/unlock buttons on key fob.

features.name: Windscreen Teardrop Wiping
features.description: Executes one final wipe 5 seconds after screenwash spray.

features.name: Rain-Closing Windows & Sunroof
features.description: Automatically closes open windows and sunroof if rain is detected while vehicle is locked.

features.name: Coming Home Automatic Mode
features.description: Coming Home lights trigger automatically on door open when dark without requiring stalk flash.
features.prerequisites: Rain/Light sensor with Auto headlight switch.

features.name: Leaving Home Illumination
features.description: Illuminates headlights upon remote unlocking at night.

features.name: DRL via Front Fog Lights
features.description: Runs front fog lamps as Daytime Running Lights instead of main dipped beams.

features.name: Dynamic Cornering Fog Lights
features.description: Turns on corresponding fog lamp when steering or indicating at low speed.

features.name: Deactivate DRL with Handbrake
features.description: Turns off daytime running lamps whenever parking brake is engaged.

features.name: Rear Wiper on Reverse Gear
features.description: Wipes rear window when reverse gear is selected with front wipers running.

features.name: Emergency Brake Hazard Flashing
features.description: Flashes hazard lights under emergency deceleration.

features.name: Highway Comfort Turn Signals (3 Flashes)
features.description: 3 turn indicator flashes on light tap of stalk.
